Edward Jones, Merrill, and Raymond James do not report a comparable revenue-yield figure in the documents searched. Because the Schwab figure is a relative multiple rather than an absolute yield and the Morgan Stanley figure is limited to fee-based assets, the two are not comparable; no shared-period, same-definition yield exists on which to rank the firms.
